vc_checking.summary: All three cleaned manual return witnesses are semantically provable from the current generated preconditions and canonical case-library definitions. The success witness converts allocator undef_full ownership to the exact mixed_full repeat-None backing resource, while the two failure witnesses package their existing ownership into the exact canonical failure resource. No annotation repair or new helper declaration is required.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: UCharArray.undef_full retval_2 aligned_u plus exact ownership of all eight CircularArea descriptor fields, where aligned_u = unsigned_last_nbits ((circular_area_length_pre ÷ 4) * 4) 32; p_head is retval_2, p_tail is retval_2 + aligned_u * sizeof(UCHAR), area_length is aligned_u, and operations is &CircularAreaOperations.
vc_shape.pre_pure: retval and retval_2 are nonzero; aligned_u > 0; readidx = 0, writeidx = 0, b_status = 0; 0 < circular_area_length_pre <= 256.
vc_shape.post_spatial: CircularAreaBackingResource retval data_buffer 0 0 aligned 0 &CircularAreaOperations nil physical, including the same descriptor ownership and UCharArray.mixed_full data_buffer aligned physical.
vc_shape.post_pure: retval <> 0; CircularAreaAlignedLength circular_area_length_pre aligned; xizi_circular_area_uninitialized aligned physical; and the pure CircularAreaLogicalState embedded in the backing resource.
vc_shape.post_exists: data_buffer : Z, physical : list (option Z), aligned : Z

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the first outer disjunct, data_buffer := retval_2, aligned := aligned_u, and physical := repeat None (Z.to_nat aligned_u).
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold CircularAreaBackingResource and xizi_circular_area_uninitialized. Apply UCharArray.undef_full_to_mixed_full to transform the allocator resource in the permitted direction. Rewrite sizeof(UCHAR) to 1 with sizeof_uchar, substitute the reset-field equalities, and cancel the eight descriptor cells and the resulting mixed_full resource.
witnesses.pure_plan: Use CircularArea_div4_aligned_range__init_return_branches to bound raw = (requested ÷ 4) * 4 in [0,2^32), then unsigned_last_nbits_eq to obtain aligned_u = raw. Use CircularArea_quot_eq_div_nonneg__init_return_branch_construction to replace quotient by nonnegative division. aligned_u > 0 then yields requested >= 4, while requested <= 256 is already a precondition. For CircularAreaLogicalState at readidx=writeidx=b_status=0, logical=nil and physical=repeat None: positivity and upper bounds come from the aligned arithmetic; Zlength nil and Zlength repeat establish lengths; the nil Forall and CircularAreaLiveBytes goals are vacuous; 0 mod aligned = 0 follows from aligned > 0; and the two b_status equivalences reduce to 0 < aligned and nil length facts.
witnesses.refinement_plan: not applicable; this is a direct spatial/pure return entailment with no safeExec state
premise_discharge: CircularArea_div4_aligned_range__init_return_branches receives requested > 0 from PreH9/PreH10 and requested <= 4294967295 from PreH11 together with 256 <= 4294967295.
UCharArray.undef_full_to_mixed_full consumes exactly the undef_full spatial conjunct and has no extra pure premise.
The nonempty-alignment facts needed for modulo, length, and empty logical-state conditions follow from PreH3 after rewriting aligned_u to raw.
witnesses.failure_signal: none; every resource and pure premise required by the canonical success resource is present or derivable without strengthening the VC
witnesses.grouping_reason: The only substantial success conversion and the two exact failure packagings all unfold the same canonical init postcondition family and can be handled sequentially by one worker.
